parameters.formDescription: Paste a job and get a tailored application package

assignments.name: resume
assignments.value:
PROFILE
Computer Science graduate (UBIT, 2025) who builds LLM applications and AI automations with Python and n8n, and tests them like production software. My work includes a bilingual voice-to-data assistant with 95% extraction accuracy on a labelled test set, and a live job-matching pipeline that checks every LLM output against its source. Three years in remote customer support showed me where teams lose time, and that is what I automate.

SKILLS
Programming: Python, SQL, Java, JavaScript (basic)
AI & LLMs: LLM APIs (Groq), prompt engineering, structured output (Pydantic), information extraction, text-to-SQL, speech-to-text (Whisper), LLM evaluation with labelled test sets
Automation & Backend: n8n, Gmail and Google Sheets APIs, OAuth 2.0, REST APIs, Streamlit, Git/GitHub, Linux
Data & Databases: PostgreSQL, SQLite, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow

PROJECTS
AwaazOps (Python, Groq Whisper and GPT-OSS 120B, Pydantic, SQLite, Streamlit)
- Built a voice-first assistant that turns Urdu, Roman Urdu and English voice notes into structured operational events, validated with Pydantic and retried once on invalid output.
- Reached 95% fully correct extraction (100% on order numbers and carton counts) with 0.7 s average latency on a labelled set of 20 messages.
- Kept decisions out of the LLM: Python rules raise alerts, results below 70% confidence go to a human approval queue, and text-to-SQL runs behind a read-only guardrail.

Job Scout (n8n, Groq GPT-OSS, Gmail API, Google Sheets API, OAuth 2.0)
- Built a live n8n workflow that reads Indeed, LinkedIn and Rozee job alerts, extracts every listing with an LLM, scores each job 1-10 against my profile with a reason, logs it to Google Sheets and emails me jobs scoring 8+.
- Blocked hallucinated jobs by checking every extracted title against the source email, and blocked duplicates across runs with a normalized company-and-title key.
- Stayed within Groq's free-tier rate limit by cleaning emails before the LLM, batching requests and using a smaller model for the scoring step.

Sales Data Analyzer & CSV-to-PostgreSQL Pipeline (Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, PostgreSQL)
- Built a Pandas/NumPy pipeline that cleans, groups and analyzes real-world sales data, replacing manual spreadsheet review with a repeatable script.
- Loaded the cleaned data into PostgreSQL and wrote SQL queries (joins, aggregations, filtering) for analysis from Python.

CV-Genie, Final Year Project (.NET Framework, AI/ML integration, SQL)
- Owned the AI-driven CV rating and ranking engine, built to process 50 CVs at a time for bulk HR review.
- Also built the bulk CV upload flow, a portfolio-website generator and an AI guidance chatbot.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Customer Support Specialist, VA Hub Pro (Remote), 2023 to present
- Managed customer queries and data/reporting tasks using Zendesk, Slack, 1Password, Loom, and GoHighLevel.
- Built automations and AI-powered chatbots that took over repetitive support responses, freeing up time for complex queries.
- Collaborated with cross-functional remote teams to keep operations running smoothly.

EDUCATION
BSCS, Karachi University (UBIT), 2022 to 2025

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You tailor Hafsa's resume for one job.
Rewrite EVERY bullet under PROJECTS and WORK EXPERIENCE in MY RESUME, all 13, in this exact order: 3 AwaazOps, 3 Job Scout, 2 Sales Data Analyzer, 2 CV-Genie, 3 VA Hub Pro.
You may change verbs and word order, and move the most relevant details to the front of a bullet.
NEVER append phrases to the end of a bullet. NEVER add new claims about who Hafsa worked with, her responsibilities or outcomes.
If a bullet does not match the job, return it unchanged. Unchanged is better than stretched.
Rules:
- Only reword. Never add a tool, skill, number, company or result that is not in MY RESUME.
- Keep every number exactly as written. Never change "built to process" into "processed".
- Keep each bullet about the same length as the original, so the resume stays one page.
- Return exactly 13 bullets.
- Keep the main idea of each bullet. Never change "Owned" to "Led". Keep "Kept decisions out of the LLM" wording.
matched_skills: only skills from the SKILLS section of MY RESUME that the job asks for.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "cover_letter": "Dear Hiring Manager, ...", "dm": "Hi, I just applied for ..." }

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You write for Hafsa Noor, a BSCS graduate applying for AI roles.
The JOB DESCRIPTION only tells you what the company wants. NEVER claim any skill, tool or experience from it.
Every claim about Hafsa must come from TAILORED BULLETS. If a job requirement is not in TAILORED BULLETS, do not mention it.
cover_letter: under 200 words. Name the company and the job title. Plain, confident tone. Do not use the words: passion, passionate, excited, eager, thrilled. End with "Hafsa Noor".
dm: a LinkedIn message to a recruiter, under 300 characters, polite and direct, mentioning the job title. Same rules.
